mechanism_narrative: A one percentage point increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by raising the discount rate for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings visibility.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), a rising CPIAUCSL signals aggressive central bank response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: In periods meeting the regime condition, the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a rising signal is below 0.03, or positive returns occur in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 2017 base level (100) signals contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a threshold signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (more than 0.1 percentage points in the past month) signals immediate labor market stress, triggering short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE rise is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 10% and RSAFS falls > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth rate is below 0.03.
